svg.title: module1_target_v1: plan view
svg.text: Module 1 at target scale: three perfused lanes, replicated fields, one sample for every omic arm
chip/module1_target_v1.json · footprint 127.76 × 85.48 mm · plan view, to scale · all dimensions mm
Every chamber and channel is 0.3 mm deep: one embossing depth, a resin-printed tool hot-embossed into the layer, with the tubing ports drilled through the lid.
Small grey names are the contracts/blocks.json CAD block each chamber and channel is built from; red means it is not in the library.
Tightest clearance between unconnected features: 0.60 mm, between chambers 'n_jl' and 'g_dn2'. Planar check: no overlaps.
